component.title: Draggable
component.purpose: A direct-manipulation surface that remains understandable and operable when pointer movement is unavailable.

states.description: A restrained card responds to pointer movement with constrained transform feedback.
Space/Enter picks up the card, arrows move it, and Escape cancels.
Movement remains inside the declared region.
Disabled state removes interaction while retaining context.

claims.statement: Pointer capture and keyboard movement share one drag state and outcome channel.
Pickup, movement, drop, and cancellation are announced through the shared live announcer.
Dragging removes layout animation and respects reduced-motion settling.
